title: SMS Delivery Failures from Twilio to Telemat Cel Brazil
impact_summary: SMS delivery to Telemat Cel network subscribers in Brazil has experienced failures, though recovery is underway.

title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe Martinique
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe network subscribers in Martinique. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 1 hour or as soon as more information becomes available.
backbase_rationale: The delays could impact timely message delivery for Backbase clients.

title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication: Send to Coworker Action Removed
impact_summary: Removal of Send to Coworker action in SendGrid Domain Authentication flow, requiring users to use alternative communication methods for DNS record updates.
backbase_rationale: To reduce low-usage feature and improve security and reliability of domain authentication setup.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.18.0
impact_summary: Raising the minimum SDK to level 24 may require updates to apps targeting lower Android versions.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must act because the SDK will no longer support older Android versions, impacting integration.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.14.0
impact_summary: The update includes accessibility compliance with WCAG 2.2 AA and EAA, ensuring better accessibility for users.
backbase_rationale: Backbase should assess whether its current implementation meets the new accessibility standards, but no immediate migration is required.
